title: HtmlMain
responsibility: Renders the native main element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlMain.attributes
inputs.description: Native main attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlMain.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native main element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlMain
outputs.description: The actual native main element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
